name: Image Dedup & Cluster
description: Find and group near-duplicate images across a folder — exact dupes, resized/re-encoded copies, and visually similar shots from the same burst — using perceptual hashing or visual similarity, then report clusters with a recommended keeper per group. Lock the similarity definition and thresholds FIRST (what counts as a duplicate vs merely similar) because the whole result hinges on that line; then analyze pairwise, cluster, and produce a human-reviewable report. Covers deduplication, near-duplicate detection, perceptual hashing, image clustering, burst grouping, and library cleanup.
